parts.name: UniFi NVR Instant
parts.notes: 220 × 220 × 47 mm, 1.04 kg. One 3.5" drive bay (11 W drive budget). 1 GbE uplink plus six 1 GbE PoE ports (15.4 W each, 40 W total), HDMI Viewport, 1.14" display. Internal 60 W PSU, 100–240 V AC; max 9 W excluding PoE and drive. Wall and DIN-rail mount included. Also sold as the UNVR-Instant-Kit, bundled with G5 Turret Ultra camera(s); only the NVR is a rack item. Too wide (220 mm) for 212 mm 10" shelves and too deep (220 mm) for 200 mm shelves.
